patthana18.14:1.1: sappaccayaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaccayo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.14:2.1: sappaccayaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaccayo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ. (saṃkhataṃ sappaccaya sadisaṃ.)
patthana18.14:3.1: anidassanaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassano na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.14:4.1: anidassanaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassano na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.14:5.1: appaṭighaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaṭigho na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.14:6.1: appaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sappaṭigho na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.14:7.1: arūpiṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na arūpī na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.14:8.1: rūpiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na rūpī na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.14:9.1: arūpiṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na arūpī na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.14:10.1: lokiyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.14:11.1: lokuttaraṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuyā cattāri,
patthana18.14:12.1: lokiyaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokuttaro na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana18.14:13.1: lokuttaraṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na lokiyo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ, hetuyā dve.
patthana18.14:14.1: kenaciviññeyyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaciviññeyyo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.14:15.1: na kenaciviññeyyaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na kenaciviññeyyo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.14:16.1: kenaciviññeyya hetuñca na kenaciviññeyyaṃ hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaciviññeyyo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, nava.
patthana18.14:17.1: kenaciviññeyyaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaciviññeyyo na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā nava.
